definitions.gloss: Otohime, princess of the Dragon Palace
definitions.explanation: The princess who welcomes Urashima Tarō to the undersea Dragon Palace ({竜宮城|りゅうぐうじょう}) in the folktale and gives him the box ({玉手箱|たまてばこ}) he must never open. Often {乙姫様|おとひめさま}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浦島太郎|うらしまたろう}→浦島太郎：33200_urashimatarou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{竜宮城|りゅうぐうじょう}→竜宮城：33487_ryuuguujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{乙姫|おとひめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: Urashima Tarō met Otohime at the Dragon Palace.

examples.japanese: {乙姫様|おとひめさま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{浦島太郎|うらしまたろう}→浦島太郎：33200_urashimatarou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{玉手箱|たまてばこ}→玉手箱：33462_tamatebako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}した→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: Princess Otohime gave Urashima Tarō a jewelled box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵本|えほん}→絵本：10429_ehon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{乙姫|おとひめ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦たいてい→たいてい：01129_taitei⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: In picture books of the folktale, Otohime is usually drawn in a beautiful kimono.

notes:
USAGE:
- Usually {乙姫様|おとひめさま}, as in the children's song 「⟦{浦島太郎|うらしまたろう}→浦島太郎：33200_urashimatarou⟧」.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- In the tale, Urashima Tarō rescues a turtle and is carried to the ⟦{竜宮城|りゅうぐうじょう}→竜宮城：33487_ryuuguujou⟧, where Otohime entertains him. When he goes home, centuries have passed; he opens the ⟦{玉手箱|たまてばこ}→玉手箱：33462_tamatebako⟧ and becomes an old man.
